description: This file defines a JobService subclass named PhotosContentJob that monitors changes to media (photos) in the Android media provider. It sets up a job with trigger content URIs to respond to specific or general media content changes, queries the media store when triggered, and displays updates via a toast message.

classes.name: PhotosContentJob
classes.description: A JobService that monitors for changes in the device's photos directory within the media provider, reacting to specific content change triggers, querying media store, and displaying updates via toast.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the PhotosContentJob using the JobScheduler.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Checks if the job is already scheduled.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled job if present.

methods.name: onStartJob
methods.description: Handles the start of the job; processes triggered content changes, queries media provider for new photos, and shows notifications.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules the job with the system's JobScheduler.

methods.name: isScheduled
methods.description: Returns true if the job is currently scheduled.
